Cost requirement: token budget per new user flow must be capped; finance target ~<$0.10 per new user onboarding flow (discussion ongoing)

requirements_summary: Workload type: chat/agent focused on onboarding/guided flows
Throughput: medium - expected concurrent onboarding sessions 200-500 at peak per region
Latency targets: first-token p95 200ms web / 300ms mobile; overall interactive stream latency <500ms for subsequent tokens
Streaming: progressive token streaming required for UX; must support partial outputs and incremental tool calls
Tool calling: reliable, low-latency calls to internal profile service and feature flagging service
Cost sensitivity: strict token budget per flow; want suggestions for batching/quantization to hit targets
Routing/fallback: prefer Hosted for fast rollout; fallback to lighter model or cached responses on degradation; Dedicated for SLA-backed stability
Security/compliance: SSO/SAML, SOC2, KMS integration, audit logs, ability to restrict data residency
